quest.title: Skycastle Saviors
quest.description: "A town floating in the sky encounters an unprecedented crisis, and a miracle-working architect must act quickly to prevent the soaring city from crashing to the ground..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of Skycastle Saviors...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x15000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: All inspections of play mechanisms complete. Anemo Particles in position...

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Hello? Hello? Is everything in place? Those abnormal Anemo Particles... they've all been taken care of, right?

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Ahem! Well then... This performance of "Skycastle Saviors," a play from "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie," will now begin!

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: This story takes place in a remote mountainous area. The people living here are constantly facing floods and storms, and their lives are filled with hardship and misery...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: In order to provide advanced warning of disasters, a group of courageous warriors built an observation post on top of a towering cliff...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Over the years, the lookouts on the high cliffs became a unique tribe, known as the "Cliff Keepers"...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The speaker continues to describe the background of the story in detail: \nThe difficulty in transporting goods to the cliffs made the lives of the Keepers even more torturous, to the point they had not a single complete home to live in.\nThe Elder of the Keepers turned to the "Miraculous Architect," renowned for their expertise. They entrusted the architect with the task of constructing a floating town in the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
The Miraculous Architect constructed a remarkable load-bearing structure, providing a solid foundation upon which all the town could be built.
Next, the Architect embedded tens of thousands of specially designed hot air balloons infused with Anemo Particles within the foundation.
The unparalleled buoyancy of the balloons effortlessly lifted the entire town to the very summit of the mountain.
The Miraculous Architect firmly anchored the town at a predetermined height, granting the Keepers a stable and cozy haven to call home...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Yet, as time marched inexorably onward, accidents began to befall the Anemo air balloons...\nThe Keepers soon found their town was slowly losing altitude, teetering on the precipice of shattering into pieces on the mountain's summit...\nA great calamity loomed, accompanied by tremors that shook the inhabitants' hearts as well as their homes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what a heavy start to the story! A floating town in the sky on the verge of falling? Now that's a crisis!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It looks like there's another speaker over there! Maybe that's where the play continues, let's go take a look.

choices.text: Let's learn more about the context...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: The Elder of the Keepers meets with the Miraculous Architect, and provides a detailed explanation of the crisis looming over the flying town...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Miraculous Architect, as you can see, each day our town continues to descend lower in the sky, and though we long to safeguard this cherished home, our haven of warmth and security, regrettably, we find ourselves helpless to do so...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: In addition, quakes have been rocking our town with immense force, alarming rumors are spreading like wildfire, and a sense of panic is now gripping the people...

dialogues.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
dialogues.text: We're all gonna get smashed! We're all gonna get smashed to smithereens!

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Esteemed Elder, I get that you're worried, and I've been hearing some rumors doubting my project's quality controls...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: But fret not! I'm here once again to resolve this crisis once and for all, alleviating your fears and dispelling any doubts you may have!

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: I just took a brief tour of the town, and took a look at the monitoring devices I had set up in the foundation. And guess what? I discovered that the fault lies with a few individual lift balloons...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: It appears that the Anemo Particle levels in certain lift balloons have dropped as if they have been intentionally damaged... However, as long as we fix them, we can prevent the town from plummeting from the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: So, to restore the town to its planned altitude, we'll need to increase the lift provided by some balloons and install additional fixed anchor cables.

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Though I should say... it's gonna cost a little extra. You see, in most cases, intentional damage isn't covered by the warranty...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: No worries. We'll increase the budget to five times the initial rate, how's that?

dialogues.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
dialogues.text: Five times! Five times!

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Oh my my, so willing to add in a bit extra, that's wonderful...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Wait, five times? Don't you think that's a bit much!? Back when this town was initially constructed, your budget was already several times what other clients paid!

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: I didn't mention this last time, but before, we ran into an exceptionally greedy craftsman. Seeing our resources, he quoted a price over 20 times the market rate.

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Luckily, we had been thorough in our research and didn't fall for it. But as a result, we have a rough idea of the true construction costs... And your bid has always been far below what would be expected...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: So you were always loaded? You guys really are... well, good at keeping a low profile.

dialogues.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
dialogues.text: We live lives of hardship so that everyone below can prosper. Everyone knows it, so they are quite generous.

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: So it is, the neighboring villages have grown wealthy, and often send us opulent gifts and donate vast sums. But our tribe has been accustomed to modest living since our days on the cliff, and so we save most of it...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Do such people really still exist in this world? Such humility...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Ahem! Regardless... I happen to be a master of cost control. I believe that increasing the rate by two and a half times is more than sufficient. Five times is a bit much, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: I must say, I'm truly impressed. Just as one would expect from a distinguished architect who has been dubbed "Miraculous"...

dialogues.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
dialogues.text: Don't want free money? Don't want free money? Idiot! Idiot!

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Hey, now! You're the bird-brain! I earn all my Mora honestly!

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: When constructing this town, my quote was only slightly higher than the cost of materials and labor. This allowed me to build the finest houses while still having enough money left over to cover my meals for two whole months...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: As for today's maintenance service, if the fees are enough to cover my travel and lodging costs for a few days, isn't that the best value for you?

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: The Elder, who just a moment ago had been moved to tears, suddenly grew annoyed and knocked out the parrot perching on his shoulder...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Ahem, we are truly grateful! The Keepers will forever cherish your kindness and tales of your noble deeds will be passed on from generation to generation...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, in our previous encounter, you had hired a Sumpter Beast caravan and brought hundreds of special storage jars. However, this time around, it seems you have arrived with minimal equipment and without any special preparation...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Ahem! You've hit the nail on the head. The primary issue at hand is finding a way to gather sufficient Anemo Particles to restore the lost lift of the balloons...

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: That's no problem! This time, we'll handle the Anemo Particles!

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Collecting them is our specialty. My people are well-versed in using Anemo Particles to forecast storms.

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Let us, the professionals, assist you in this crucial matter.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: The Elder selects two courageous Keepers — you, who have patiently waited on the sidelines.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: You have triumphed over gravity and mountain winds, effortlessly navigating the towering terrain. You are the rising stars of the Keepers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets it! It's our time to shine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This time, we're skilled Keepers, and we just need to fly all over collecting Anemo Particles! That's super easy for us.

response.speaker: Warden Elder
response.text: Very well, then we will entrust this task to you! This may be more exhausting than usual, so we will be sure the rewards are commensurate.

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: Working at heights is no joke. Please be careful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, humble Elder and honest Architect! Leave it to us! You two just fix those balloons while we go fetch the critical particles!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's go, {NICKNAME}! Let's hustle and get the job done pronto! Just have to collect enough Anemo Particles so these Keepers can keep their home!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! So these three stole the last Anemo Particles!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, were they behind the sabotage of the balloons too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ugh! {NICKNAME}, let's teach them a lesson and get those Anemo Particles back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! See the error of your ways now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No more sabotage in the future! Got it?

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: But something feels off! Have any of you seen those three before? Could they be actors that Actaholic hired?

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Where's Engineer? Did Engineer fix the sea monster's mechanisms? Hurry up and get the emergency team to the scene to handle cleanup...

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Wait, what? I'm still on the air? Ahhhh, my bad! I'll turn it off now!

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Thankfully, the guests were able to handle the sudden emergency themselves... We definitely can't make this mistake again!

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: After overcoming all kinds of challenging trials, pretty much all the Anemo Particles were successfully collected. The two Keepers were so focused that they didn't realize that more than half a month has passed.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: The Miraculous Architect comes through in a big way, swiftly repairing the lift balloons in the town's foundation...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The narrator on the speaker... sounds a bit anxious, don't you think?

choices.text: Was that part of the show?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's got no clue. But it's probably not important. Let's get back to the play!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The narrator mentioned that we've jumped ahead like half a month in time, which saves us from waiting for the architect to fix the balloons. Let's go and meet them now!

talks.objective: Talk to the Elder and the architect

dialogues.speaker: Warden Elder
dialogues.text: Welcome back! It could not have been easy, please, enjoy a hard-earned rest.

dialogues.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
dialogues.text: Bravo! Bravo!

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: You look around and notice that the Miraculous Architect has already repaired all the damaged balloons.\nOnce the Anemo Particles are ready, the disaster will have been completely averted.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: The Elder calls upon the other Keepers, who arrive with steaming hot food and refreshing drinks. Your efficiency has also left the Miraculous Architect stupefied, staring in awe.

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: You already completed the collection? That's a full five days faster than my expectations! No wonder the Elder said you guys were pros...

dialogues.speaker: Miraculous Architect
dialogues.text: Now that we have enough Anemo Particles, I'll replenish the lift balloons without further ado!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The narration from the loudspeaker paints the following scene:\n\nThe Miraculous Architect whips out a nifty gadget and dashes around, spreading the Anemo Particles you gathered through preset interfaces to devices scattered all across the foundation.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With the lift provided by the balloons restored, the abnormal vibrations come to a sudden halt.\nThe village ceases its descent and gradually ascends back to its original altitude, while the powerful air currents disperse the vast expanse of clouds...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The once-somber sky clears, and the town is once more embraced by radiant sunshine. The Keepers erupt in celebration...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! The town won't plummet to the ground, and the crisis has been solved. Time for a round of applause!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... why are we staring up? It's all in our imaginations anyway, and we're still on the floating town anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's neck is sore!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about this: when we get the chance, let's find an expert to illustrate this story... or even better, turn it into a film! Paimon has a hunch that it's going to be a major hit!

choices.text: Maybe Daiya has the same idea.

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: As the ground beneath his feet finally stops shaking, the elder takes a long breath, feeling so moved that he begins to tear up.

response.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
response.text: The town is safe! The town is safe!

response.speaker: Warden Elder
response.text: Fantastic! Fantastic... Now we Keepers can carry on with our duty!

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: Success... This repair project went off without a hitch, and it's definitely worthy of being written into a thesis... Oh boy, it's a perfect example that could even make it into a textbook!

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: I won't have to worry about food expenses for the next two months. Hmm, what kind of marvelous creation shall I dream up...

response.speaker: Warden Elder
response.text: But, if I may, it appears that the town is still ascending, and if it surpasses its original altitude... when will it come to a stop?

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: Oops!

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: I may have been so focused on fixing the balloons that I forgot to secure the anchor rope to counteract the lift...

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: No need to panic... The town is rising at a relatively slow speed, and we can use smaller cargo balloons to attach the anchor! It'll be a cinch.

response.speaker: Warden Elder
response.text: I see. I thought that after witnessing the success of these two heroes, you came to the conclusion that we could all walk up walls and live in the sky...

response.speaker: Warden Elder
response.text: Ha! The Keepers aren't as mighty as that... Please address this issue as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
response.text: Ask for more money? Ask for more money?

response.speaker: Impolite Mockingbird
response.text: Earn a bit more? Earn a bit more?

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: Sure, if the Elder would like to build a lavish birdcage and confine you within it until you learn proper speech etiquette and business ethics...

response.speaker: Miraculous Architect
response.text: Forget about any extra charge. I'll cover it myself!

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: Despite the little hiccup at the end, the story wrapped up beautifully.

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: Thus as always, the troubles of the Cliff Keepers were resolved by the Miraculous Architect.

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: This floating town in the sky will keep on supporting the Cliff Keepers, ensuring lasting peace and prosperity in the region...

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: And thus, "Skycastle Saviors" comes to an end. Thanks for watching!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Encore, encore! The curtains have fallen, and even though it wasn't perfect, Paimon thought it was decent!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon was a wealthy merchant, Paimon would invest a ton of money into "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie" and make every prop and scene amazing!

choices.text: Let's look into that when the opportunity arises.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Absolutely! Paimon hopes we get a chance to meet the mysterious Daiya!

choices.text: We need to gain a solid understanding of their financials before investing...
I bet it's mainly budget issues.
